mapper.select: SELECT sys01_company_id AS companyId , sys01_icam_advis_company_cd AS icamCompanyCode FROM sys01_company WHERE CAST(sys01_company_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE #{companyId} AND sys01_icam_advis_company_cd IS NOT NULL AND sys01_use_yn = 'true' AND sys01_erp_product_cd IN ('S3','A1')

SELECT adv02_account_id AS accountId , adv02_company_id AS companyId , adv02_manage_cd AS manageCode , adv02_manage_nm AS manageName , adv02_tr_corp_cd AS trCorpCode , adv02_tr_corp_nm AS trCorpName , TO_DECRYPTS(adv02_account_no) AS accountNoDec , adv02_start_date AS startDate , adv02_close_date AS closeDate , adv02_worker AS worker FROM adv02_account WHERE adv02_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv02_manage_cd = #{manageCode}
